setting.statement: WHEN I set my text size to 200% I SEE the title, body and links grow with it, with no loss of information.

The card is named by its title in aria-label.
I SEE its body as a paragraph.
WHEN I move into the card with a desktop screen reader (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) I HEAR its title, the role of region, and its title again as a heading at its level.
WHEN I Tab to a link in the card I HEAR the link's own name, clear without the card around it.

criteria.name: The card's title.

setting.statement: WHEN I set my system text size to 200% I SEE the title, body and links grow with it, with no loss of information.
WHEN I magnify the window with the system zoom I SEE the card whole.

check.statement: A card adds no stop of its own to the window's tab order.
I SEE the title as a heading over the body.
WHEN I move into the card with a screen reader (VoiceOver, Orca, Narrator) I HEAR its title as a heading.

criteria.note: GPUI 0.2.2 exposes no accessibility tree (no AccessKit): every HEAR check fails on this face today. Its SEE checks with a probe run on GPUI's test platform (gpui/src/native.rs), which no CI job runs yet (gpui/README.md, Verification); the rest are reported as not verified.
